meaning:
Ὀνήσιμος, -ου, ὁ
(i.e. profitable, ὄνησις, profit),
Onesimus: Col.4:9, Phm 10 (a common name among slaves; see MM, iii, xviii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,
